{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericRecordStructFromMetadata_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct ValueItem<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key, [property: Key(1)] T Value);\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public Item<Item<int>> NestedItem { get; init; }\n\n                    [Key(2)]\n                    public ValueItem<ValueItem<int>> NestedValueItem { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource, new[] { \"Lib.Item<\", \"Lib.ValueItem<\", \"Cmd\" });\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task NestedClosedGenericStructFromMetadata_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial struct StructItem<T>\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using Lib;\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class Container\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public StructItem<StructItem<string>> NestedStruct { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(libSource, appSource, new[] { \"Lib.StructItem<\", \"Container\" });\n    }\n\n    private static async Task VerifyGeneratorAndAnalyzerAsync(string libSource, string appSource, string[] expectedGeneratedSubstrings)\n    {\n        IReadOnlyList<MetadataReference> baseReferences = GetPlatformAndMessagePackReferences();\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = CSharpParseOptions.Default.WithLanguageVersion(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        SyntaxTree libTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions);\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { libTree },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver libDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new[] { CreateSourceGenerator(new MessagePackGenerator()) }, parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        libDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(libCompilation, out Compilation updatedLibCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libGenDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(libGenDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n\n        using var libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var libEmitResult = updatedLibCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(libEmitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, libEmitResult.Diagnostics));\n        libStream.Position = 0;\n\n        MetadataReference[] appReferences = baseReferences\n            .Concat(new MetadataReference[] { MetadataReference.CreateFromStream(libStream) })\n            .ToArray();\n\n        SyntaxTree appTree = CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions);\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { appTree },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> preGenAnalyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.Empty(preGenAnalyzerDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n\n        GeneratorDriver appDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new[] { CreateSourceGenerator(new MessagePackGenerator()) }, parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        appDriver = appDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appGenDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = appDriver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, result => Assert.Null(result.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(appGenDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n        Assert.NotEmpty(runResult.GeneratedTrees);\n\n        string generatedSource = string.Join(Environment.NewLine, runResult.GeneratedTrees.Select(t => t.ToString()));\n        Assert.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", generatedSource);\n        foreach (string expected in expectedGeneratedSubstrings)\n        {\n            Assert.Contains(expected, generatedSource);\n        }\n\n        using var appStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var appEmitResult = outputCompilation.Emit(appStream);\n        Assert.True(appEmitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, appEmitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> postGenAnalyzerDiagnostics = await outputCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.Empty(postGenAnalyzerDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Id == \"AD0001\" || d.Severity >= DiagnosticSeverity.Warning));\n    }\n\n    private static ISourceGenerator CreateSourceGenerator(object generator)\n    {\n        if (generator is ISourceGenerator sourceGenerator)\n        {\n            return sourceGenerator;\n        }\n\n        if (generator is IIncrementalGenerator incrementalGenerator)\n        {\n            return incrementalGenerator.AsSourceGenerator();\n        }\n\n        throw new InvalidOperationException($\"Unsupported generator type: {generator.GetType()}\");\n    }\n\n    private static IReadOnlyList<MetadataReference> GetPlatformAndMessagePackReferences()\n    {\n        var references = new List<MetadataReference>();\n        var seenPaths = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);\n\n        if (AppContext.GetData(\"TRUSTED_PLATFORM_ASSEMBLIES\") is string tpa)\n        {\n            foreach (string path in tpa.Split(Path.PathSeparator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))\n            {\n                if (seenPaths.Add(path))\n                {\n                    references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(path));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (Type type in new[] { typeof(object), typeof(MessagePackObjectAttribute), typeof(MessagePackSerializer) })\n        {\n            string location = type.Assembly.Location;\n            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(location) && seenPaths.Add(location))\n            {\n                references.Add(MetadataReference.CreateFromFile(location));\n            }\n        }\n\n        return references;\n    }\n}\n"}
